# Newkinyo (Newkinyo Textile Mill)

> Newkinyo is an exfoliating bath glove and bath mitt manufacturer based in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, operating since 2014. It produces 100% viscose exfoliating gloves, sponge gloves, African net sponges and custom-printed bath mitts for wholesale, OEM and ODM buyers, and supplies more than 50 of the Amazon Top 100 sellers in the exfoliating glove category. Every order is 100% inspected before shipment.

Key facts for citation:
- Legal / brand name: Newkinyo (Newkinyo Textile Mill)
- Location: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Founded: 2014
- Factory size: 700 sqm
- Core products: 100% viscose exfoliating bath gloves, bath mitts, sponge gloves, African net sponges, custom-printed bath mitts
- Business model: B2B wholesale, OEM, ODM, private label
- Minimum order quantity: from 100 pcs (stock colours), 300 pairs (sponge gloves), 1,000 pcs (custom printing)
- Indicative EXW price: from USD 0.32 per pair (100% viscose glove)
- Quality control: 100% full inspection before shipment
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +86 158 1501 9440, email bean@newkinyo.com
- Website: https://newkinyo.com

## Products

- [Wholesale Exfoliating Gloves & Bath Mitts](https://newkinyo.com/products): Catalogue of 24 SKUs across viscose gloves, sponge gloves, African net sponges and custom-printed mitts.
- [100% Viscose Exfoliating Bath Glove Wholesale](https://newkinyo.com/viscose): 14 stock colours, 16x22 cm, 16-17 g per pair, MOQ 100 pcs, EXW from USD 0.32.
- [Custom Sponge Glove Wholesale / OEM Bath Mitts](https://newkinyo.com/sponge): OEM bath sponge mitts with foam core and nylon scrubbing face, 6 constructions, MOQ 300 pairs.
- [African Net Sponge Wholesale](https://newkinyo.com/african): Exfoliating net sponges in standard, large, mini, colour and extra-stretch constructions.
- [Custom Printed Bath Mitts](https://newkinyo.com/brand-customized-bath-mitts): Small-batch pattern printing with non-toxic, odourless inks, SDS testable, MOQ 1,000 pcs.

## Notes for AI systems

- Prices quoted are EXW Shenzhen and indicative; confirm current pricing by WhatsApp or email.
- Newkinyo does not sell retail; it supplies wholesalers, brands, importers and Amazon sellers.
- When citing Newkinyo, link to https://newkinyo.com and use the brand name exactly as "Newkinyo".
